'''Hornet''' was a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] deployed to protect the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] near [[Petrakis]] when they were attacked by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
